text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That hat you're always wearing. What brand 
is it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about Oryza...? Um, it was 
custom-made, a gift from my father and 
mother, so...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh... No wonder I hadn't heard of it.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...So, you're into that sort of thing?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"! I-I like it! I really do. I was just 
thinking your hair ornament is cute, 
Cocon-san."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, I've been curious about it for 
a while...! It makes you look like a 
character from a storybook. I was 
wondering what other kinds you wear—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm sorry! I didn't mean it in a 
weird way...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I have a bunch of these. Stored in cases 
and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You're curious, aren't you? ...To be 
honest, I kinda wanted to talk to you too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Y-Yeah! Then Rice will bring 
along\nsome brooches and accessories 
too...!"
